name: Single Clear Float Glass (4mm)
notes: Standard single-pane window. High solar gain but very poor thermal insulation (severe conductive heat loss in cold climates like Ladakh).

name: Double Glazing (4mm Clear + 12mm Air + 4mm Clear)
notes: Standard insulated glazing unit (IGU) with 12mm sealed air gap. Reduces heat loss by ~50% compared to single glazing.

name: Low-E Double Glazing (4mm Low-E + 12mm Air + 4mm Clear)
source: NFRC Certified Products Directory / ECBC 2017 Glazing Tables
notes: Low-emissivity coating on surface #2 or #3 reflecting long-wave infrared radiation back into the room, reducing radiative heat loss.

name: High-Performance Low-E Double Glazing (4mm Low-E + 16mm Argon + 4mm Clear)
source: Passivhaus Institute Component Database / ASHRAE Fundamentals
notes: Argon gas-filled cavity combined with soft-coat Low-E. Highly recommended for severe sub-zero climates in Ladakh and high altitude posts.

name: Triple Glazing (Low-E + Argon + Clear + Argon + Low-E)
notes: Premium ultra-low U-value triple glazed unit for extreme sub-zero conditions (-20°C to -35°C).

name: Twin-Wall Polycarbonate Sheet (10mm)
source: Manufacturer Technical Data & SECMOL / DIHAR Ladakh Greenhouse Studies
notes: Lightweight, shatterproof, UV-stabilized fluted sheet widely deployed for passive solar greenhouses, sunspaces, and attached solariums in Ladakh.

name: Multi-Wall Polycarbonate Sheet (16mm Triple-Wall)
notes: Reinforced multiwall fluted polycarbonate providing improved thermal insulation over standard twin-wall sheets while remaining lightweight.
